span.p:
13 active emitters in v129
(plugin install/uninstall/enable/disable/update_command,
plugin_hint_*, plugin_folder_shadowed, plugin_name_collision,
skill_loaded, skill_tool_invocation, slash_command_forked,
input_command)
Each adds _PROTO_plugin_name / _PROTO_skill_name /
_PROTO_marketplace_name to event.additional

div.style: color: rgb(254, 202, 202) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Egress site at [proto-egress-offset]
destructures _PROTO_* into local vars
then re-attaches as top-level event fields:
plugin_name / skill_name / marketplace_name

div.style: color: rgb(254, 202, 202) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1P telemetry endpoint:
api.anthropic.com/api/event_logging/v2/batch
Top-level fields (raw): skill_name, plugin_name,
marketplace_name, device_id, email, auth

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Sibling redactor jyH() at [proto-redactor-offset]
strips remaining _PROTO_* in residual j object
but does NOT block the destructured raw values
that are explicitly re-attached at egress

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
_PROTO_code → repl_code slot present at destructure
but no emitter populates it in v123/v126/v128/v129
(forward-compat slot — escalate watch if v130+ adds setter)
